reports.one_liner: ITC is a diversified Indian conglomerate whose profit is still dominated by cigarettes, alongside a fast-growing packaged foods and personal care business, paperboard/packaging, and agri-trading; it demerged its hotels business into a separately listed company in January 2025.
Wipro is a Bengaluru-based IT services and consulting company that writes software, runs client IT systems and offers engineering/BPO services, mostly billed to large overseas clients in dollars.
